_doc: Ledger of every fix relayed to Mahmood across audits 20-27. State vocabulary is FOUR-valued and never folded: LANDED_AND_LIVE (committed, pushed, AND the live URL fetched+read) / LANDED_NOT_LIVE (committed+pushed, live not re-verified) / IN_PROGRESS (lane or edit open now) / QUEUED (nothing started). corpus_reach = of 32 topics, how many the fix has actually reached in the SERVED pages (a code fix not rebuilt into the pages is NOT applied). The pre-commit gate enforces reproduce-all on every machinery commit, so a COMMITTED template fix reaches 32/32 by construction; the historical staleness that let audits 25-27 re-find 'fixed' things was the AGGREGATE docs/*.json artefacts, which were not gated until the leak-scanner limb (fa2b45d).
